methodology: Evidence retrieval only. Both modes have identical 8000-character caps, exact cl100k_base token caps, top-five page limits and source-preserving assembly. Semantic changes rankings and may lose lexical evidence; report every gain and loss. Labels stay evaluator-side and never enter index/ranking/packing. Report budget, source-span, project-scope, metadata, source-stability and repeated-output invariants. Existing public/synthetic/authored sets are regression data; Hotpot128 is a bounded scoped-distractor multi-hop corpus, not full-Wikipedia or conversational-memory generalization. Model pretraining overlap is unknown. One model, six authored domains and one external corpus cannot establish universal semantic memory or final-answer accuracy. A worse or slower semantic candidate is retained and documented, not tuned on this cohort or silently dropped.
